'''Oroku's Slicers''' are [[Unique item|unique]] [[daggers]] dropped by [[Imperial Guard Lockbox]]es. As the name suggests, they belong to [[Oroku (Ministry of Purity)|Oroku]].

== Stats ==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 7-17 (Requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Enchantment spell|Enchanted]])
:[[Energy]] gain on hit: 1
:[[Energy regeneration]] -1
:[[Armor rating|Armor]] +5

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as [[Shinobi Blade]]s, but it is dual wielded.
